props.name: items
props.description: Everything that can be found. Ten thousand is fine: scoring runs in slices between frames.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the search field.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen item — Enter, or a click.

props.name: limit
props.description: Keep at most this many ranked results.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the result list, in pixels.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of one result row, in pixels. Rows are virtualised, so this must be exact.
